context.transcript:
a meeting.
Remember that our annual building inspection will take
place this Friday. ®Before you leave on Thursday, please
make sure all documents are locked in your desk drawers
to help protect our client-related information. Speaking of
clients, several clients have requested that we be on call to
answer questions in the evenings. ®We'll be implementing
that for select clients next month. Evening work hours will
be discussed at next week's meeting.
